findings.text: follow-on: baseline_suite is empty while after_suite is populated, so the reviewed node's own done-when requirement that the two files be recorded as flat baseline_suite and after_suite records is unmet and the added-failure delta cannot be read from the manifest alone.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 556e5b6f; fc4b2c1a adds refuse_widen_scope_conflicts and calls it from crew_widen, 373c7bfd and de6129adb build the repo-backed free-path and held-path cases, and 80aead778 routes widening through dispatch's _raise_repository_scope_conflict with the widened run excluded from its own claims.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_fence_widening.py's two cases run over a temporary RECKON_HOME and repository with the two files recorded as flat baseline_suite and after_suite records; the manifest records after_suite (parity-after.log, 10 passed) but leaves baseline_suite empty, so the base arm survives only under tests/test_logs/artifacts and the run's separate base logs.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a durable, safe scope extension -- reckon crew widen adds a path no other live claim holds and it reaches the promoted ledger row, while a peer-held path is refused naming its holder with the widened run's pointer byte-identical; reckon/cli.py:5577-5581 routes newly added paths through dispatch admission.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it carries the four commits, changed_paths, the after_suite flat record with its log_path, the negative_control_log path, and a checkpoint that defers the baseline and merged population arms to the coordinator.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/cli.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_fence_widening.py, an evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff touches only the three code and test paths, all inside the declared set.

justifications.durability: tests/test_fence_widening.py:292 asserts the refusal names the holder and that pointer_path(BLOCKED_RUN_ID).read_bytes() is unchanged, an independent read of the pointer file rather than the value the command returned.
justifications.evidence: the head arm reproduces at 80aead778 (tests/test_fence_widening.py, 10 passed, EXIT=0) and the base arm is parity-before.log (1 failed, 1 passed), but the manifest's baseline_suite field at manifest.md:20 is empty, so the reviewed run's paired flat record is incomplete and the added-failure delta had to be re-derived from the run's own base and head logs.
justifications.fit: refuse_widen_scope_conflicts (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2826) reuses _raise_repository_scope_conflict and _repository_scope_claims in the module's own idiom and introduces no name the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/cli.py:5580 calls refuse_widen_scope_conflicts inside the locked pointer write, so a held added path raises before node["write_paths"] is set and an admitted one is carried into the record promotion reads.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the declared write paths and the change is only the widening check, its docstring, and the tests, with no unrelated edit.
